description: Energy and water usage of large buildings in Ontario is a dataset listed in Ontario open data catalogue, an open data portal, published or maintained by data.ontario.ca. Get data on the intensity of energy and water usage and greenhouse gas (GHG) emissions as well as property use types for buildings larger than 100,000 square feet. Where possible, data is weather-normalized. Data is not cleansed. Coverage: Ontario. Its tags are ACPREE, EWRB, Environment and Natural Resources, Environnement et richesses naturelles, Infrastructure and Transportation. It offers 16 resource(s) in XLSX. The portal shows 2026-08-13 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open Government Licence – Ontario. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-ontario-portal.
